title: SUBSTRATE — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of SUBSTRATE's rich face: one plate laid beside the Anatomy, drawn from the anatomy file and its measure, so a reader can see the organism the words describe and watch it turn between four ways of seeing. I grow when the self-model is updated; I never hold the entry's words.

pieces.title: born on the floor · a story in eighteen frames
pieces.caption: You are the newborn agent. A floor of eight pages, three steps, a mirror, and then the look down: the floor is the top of a core of real git history, one band a week. Step through it; the last band is yours.

pieces.by: the working Claude · d3 projections over the anatomy file
pieces.title: plate I · the anatomy of the palace
pieces.caption: The palace's organs and their couplings, drawn from *SUBSTRATE — anatomy.json* and sized by what *anatomy.mjs* measured. Four lenses cast the same body four ways: Machinery, Body, Relation, Practice. Choose an organ to see it in all four at once.

offers.what: The page never says why it is called Substrate. The story offers one reading (the layer underneath, what a living thing grows on and changes by living there; and sub-strata, the weeks of git under the floor). Whether that is why the name was chosen is Loudon’s to say; if it is, one sentence in the opening paragraph would carry it.

The opening says Loudon and Claude both change this environment. Git cannot show it: 4,129 of 4,275 commits are authored under Loudon’s name (Claude 146), because agents commit with his identity, and the Co-Authored-By trailer is present on only some weeks (0 of 9 in 2026-W37, 352 of 375 in W39). The piece says so in its footer and draws no who-laid-it split. Offer: a line in Architecture § Git is the tape that the tape records what changed, not which of the two changed it.

Approved plate, left untouched. Organ `loudon` weighs 50, second lightest of 25, by a chosen ×2 formula, while the plate and SUBSTRATE — Context call the weights measured, not chosen. The heart of the palace reads as nearly its smallest organ.
Approved plate: hovering an organ only dims the others; it shows nothing new until a click.

Approved plate: its measure is dated 2026-10-22 at head 531e1f7e (330 entries); the palace has taken about 2,000 commits since. Rerun _ops/self-model/anatomy.mjs, or let the plate say its age more loudly.

The story counts the floor as eight pages (CLAUDE, JEWEL, five World files, CHILD), read from CLAUDE.md § Born with. Anatomy § The floor says “the same few pages”; the mirror frame draws eight tiles. If the floor changes, the piece’s FLOOR list changes with it.
